scopeStatement: This contract records current enforcement boundaries. It does not assert a global suspension orchestrator, cross-plane convergence, token auth-epoch enforcement, or a platform kill switch where the implementation has not established one.

authoritativeSource.statement: The exact target plane owns tenant, principal, and group deny evidence for its business permissions.

mechanisms: Exact-plane resolver evaluates active, effective authz.deny_rule rows with absolute precedence over allow evidence.

convergence.statement: The deny is authoritative after its local database transaction commits; no cross-plane propagation is implied.

propagation.failureBehavior: Authorization fails closed when the exact-plane database is unavailable; a deny created in one plane does not silently deny another plane.

required: deny_rule identity, subject, permission, scope, reason, effective interval, actor, and status history

recovery.authority: Authorized security operator in the owning plane
steps: Suspend or revoke the exact deny rule through a runtime mutation API.
Do not delete immutable audit evidence.
verification: Resolve the affected principal in the exact plane.
Verify the deny proof is absent only after the approved effective time.

limitations: This is a permission-and-scope deny, not identity suspension, tenant suspension, session revocation, or a platform kill switch.

authoritativeSource.statement: Each physical plane owns its principal and plane-membership admission state.

mechanisms: Exact-plane resolver requires active master.principal and active, currently effective authz.plane_membership rows.

convergence.statement: New exact-plane authorization resolutions deny after the local status transaction commits; other planes are unchanged.

propagation.failureBehavior: The exact-plane resolver fails closed when admission state cannot be read. Existing identity-provider and BFF sessions are not claimed to be revoked by this control.

required: principal or membership status transition, actor, reason, request correlation, and affected tenant
gaps: Token auth_epoch is not currently compared with master.principal.auth_epoch by the exact-plane resolver.

recovery.authority: Authorized tenant security administrator in each affected plane
steps: Reactivate the principal and membership separately in every intended plane.
Re-resolve authorization instead of restoring cached permission claims.
verification: Verify active principal and membership state per plane.
Verify suspended principals remain denied in planes not explicitly recovered.

limitations: There is no orchestrator that applies principal suspension to Studio, Neon, and Mesh together.
Local auth_epoch storage alone does not prove session invalidation.

authoritativeSource.statement: Plane-local master.tenant is authoritative for local tenant admission; Studio TrustIAM owns desired organization and application-projection lifecycle.

mechanisms: Studio reconciliation can carry an organization application-projection lifecycle to an exact target plane.
propagation.orchestrator: Studio projection reconciliation worker covers application-projection desired state only

convergence.statement: Local tenant suspension is transactional. End-to-end organization suspension across every plane has no established SLO or convergence proof.

propagation.failureBehavior: A local inactive tenant fails exact-plane admission. Reconciliation failure remains visible as pending, drifted, failed, or dead-letter evidence and must not be described as globally converged.

gaps: No single command currently proves that organization suspension changed every plane tenant admission state.

recovery.authority: Studio organization authority plus an authorized operator for each plane-local tenant
steps: Restore the approved Studio desired state.
Replay dead-lettered exact-version reconciliation attempts where required.
Reactivate each plane-local tenant only after projection hash verification.
verification: Verify desired and observed version/hash for every target projection.
Verify master.tenant admission state in each intended plane.

limitations: Application projection controls organization-level application admission and is not a principal-specific suspension mechanism.
Organization suspension does not itself prove identity-provider session revocation.

authoritativeSource.statement: The identity provider owns upstream login sessions; the BFF session store owns Athyper relay sessions.

mechanisms: BFF can revoke an identified relay session from its session store.

convergence.statement: Individual mechanisms exist, but no durable fan-out workflow or measured convergence objective joins provider and all BFF sessions.

propagation.failureBehavior: Database suspension must still deny new exact-plane authorization. Failure to revoke an upstream or relay session remains an explicit security incident and retry condition.

required: subject, realm, actor, reason, and correlation ID
gaps: No durable combined revocation receipt across provider and every plane session binding.

steps: Restore provider login eligibility only after the suspension incident is resolved.
Require a new authenticated session; never resurrect revoked relay-session material.
verification: Verify old provider and relay sessions cannot refresh.
Verify new login receives only currently admitted plane contexts.

limitations: Principal database status, provider sessions, and BFF sessions are separate authorities and are not currently coordinated by one workflow.

coordinates: No canonical platform authorization kill-switch source is published
authoritativeSource.statement: No authoritative source has been assigned for a Studio, Neon, and Mesh authorization kill switch.

mechanisms: No implemented propagation mechanism; incident responders must use separately authorized local controls.

convergence.statement: No convergence guarantee or SLO exists.

propagation.failureBehavior: The platform must not report a global shutdown. Operators must treat every plane as potentially available until exact local verification succeeds.

gaps: No source table or service API.
No all-plane acknowledgement or recovery workflow.

recovery.authority: Future platform security incident commander under dual control
steps: Recover separately applied local controls under their owning authorities.
verification: Do not claim platform recovery without future durable acknowledgements from all intended planes.

limitations: This entry is a required design boundary, not an implemented control.

deliveryPriorities.title: Projection ownership design and role integration tests
Trusted-device expiry reconciliation and resolver test

removedClaims: Global suspension automatically propagates through principal status, membership, Keycloak revocation, auth epoch, and projection suspension.
Application projection is a principal-specific suspension mechanism.
W1 is the only release blocker.
reportCorrections.releaseBlockerStatement: W1A, W1B, W2, and W5 are release blockers; W4 is an operational release criterion, followed by W3 and W6 as separately tracked security and control work.
